quotes.text: We had the most incredible experience on our recent boat trip with Stepan, and I cannot recommend him highly enough! From the moment we stepped aboard, it was clear that we were in the hands of a true professional. Stepan's hospitality and customer service were exceptional, making our day on the water truly unforgettable. Our adventure took us to the stunning Bowen Island and around the picturesque Vancouver Harbour. What really stood out was Stepan's commitment to ensuring our comfort and satisfaction...

We had an amazing experience with Stepan. The boat was super clean and Stepan was a great host. We celebrated my dad’s birthday on the boat and Stepan guided on when we should cut the cake. He had snacks and drinks for us to enjoy on the boat as well as clicked pictures. Even when we spilled on the boat, he was very kind and cleaned the boat. Will definitely recommend for a great experience

We spent a very memorable evening celebrating 3 birthdays on Stephan’s beautiful boat. He greeted us with champagne, strawberries and trail mix and very warm welcome. He was very knowledgeable about the area in Vancouver and he allowed time for the family to celebrate. We would recommend Captain Stepan again, and we are looking forward to booking our next adventure with him!

Stepan was amazing! Not only he provides OUTSTANDING customer service, but his boat is wonderful and has everything we needed. Stepan had a genuine interest in giving his guests the best possible experience and was very accommodating. Thank you Stepan for the great time in your boat! It was our friends’ highlight of their visit to Vancouver!

The entire experience was amazing. Stepan is one of the nicest people you will meet and the boat is perfect for 4-6 people. He provides a very friendly and safe environment and has plenty of refreshments available for your group. I will 100% book again with Stepan and encourage anyone thinking of going on the water to use him!

Our day with Stepan was extraordinarily enjoyable - his boat is well-suited for a group of six adults, and its galley (kitchen), head (toilet) and deck areas are spacious, impeccably clean and well-maintained. Stepan is not only a seasoned mariner, but also a very warm host - we look forward to our next trip with him!
